title: Reconstruction Workmanship Warranty Certificate Terms by Agreement
content:
Each Reconstruction agreement carries a workmanship warranty on these terms.

| Agreement | Warranty term | Inspection within | Owner-supplied materials covered | Trip charge when not covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 12 months | 5 business days | No | $95.00 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 12 months | 5 business days | No | $125.00 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 24 months | 5 business days | No | $125.00 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 24 months | 3 business days | No | $125.00 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 12 months | 5 business days | No | $125.00 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 12 months | 3 business days | No | $175.00 |

## Terms used

- **Warranty term**: the months after substantial completion during which workmanship defects are repaired at no charge.
- **Inspection within**: the business days (Monday-Friday excluding company holidays) to inspect a reported warranty defect.
- **Owner-supplied materials covered**: whether the workmanship warranty extends to materials the owner supplied; on every agreement it does not.
- **Trip charge when not covered**: the trip charge when a warranty inspection finds the reported item is not a covered workmanship defect, in US dollars.

## Comparing agreements

The Major Rebuild Agreement and the Full Structural Rebuild Agreement carry the longer 24-month term; the others carry 12 months. The Full Structural Rebuild Agreement and the Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement inspect within 3 business days rather than 5.
